sql.if: AND ( (CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN COALESCE(l.prev_buyer_name, o.buyer_name) ELSE COALESCE(l.buyer_name, o.buyer_name) END) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR (CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN COALESCE(l.prev_buyer_phone, o.buyer_phone) ELSE COALESCE(l.buyer_phone, o.buyer_phone) END) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST((CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN COALESCE(l.prev_buyer_id, o.buyer_id) ELSE COALESCE(l.buyer_id, o.buyer_id) END) AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN -o.total_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN -o.total_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 2 THEN o.total_amount ELSE o.total_amount END ), 0) FROM t_rob_order_operate_log l INNER JOIN t_rob_order o ON o.id = l.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS n) split ON l.operate_type = 3 WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT l.id AS log_id, l.operate_type AS event_type, l.create_time AS event_time, o.create_time AS order_create_time, l.order_id, o.order_no, o.goods_id, o.goods_name, o.goods_sn, o.goods_thumb, o.session_id, o.session_name, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN COALESCE(l.prev_buyer_id, o.buyer_id) ELSE COALESCE(l.buyer_id, o.buyer_id) END AS buyer_id, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN COALESCE(l.prev_buyer_name, o.buyer_name) ELSE COALESCE(l.buyer_name, o.buyer_name) END AS buyer_name, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN COALESCE(l.prev_buyer_phone, o.buyer_phone) ELSE COALESCE(l.buyer_phone, o.buyer_phone) END AS buyer_phone, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN -o.quantity WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 2 THEN o.quantity ELSE o.quantity END AS flow_quantity, o.unit_price, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN -o.total_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN -o.total_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 2 THEN o.total_amount ELSE o.total_amount END AS signed_total_amount, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN -l.receipt_round_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN -l.receipt_round_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 2 THEN l.receipt_round_amount ELSE l.receipt_round_amount END AS signed_receipt_amount, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN -l.payment_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN -l.payment_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 2 THEN l.payment_amount ELSE l.payment_amount END AS signed_payment_amount, l.operate_user_id AS operator_id, l.operate_user_name AS operator_name, l.remark FROM t_rob_order_operate_log l INNER JOIN t_rob_order o ON o.id = l.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS n) split ON l.operate_type = 3 WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, l.id DESC, split.n DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN o.profit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_profit_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN o.profit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_profit_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN o.recommend_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_recommend_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN o.recommend_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_recommend_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN o.self_buy_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_self_buy_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN o.self_buy_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_self_buy_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN o.self_buy_bonus_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_self_buy_bonus_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN o.self_buy_bonus_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_self_buy_bonus_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN o.self_buy_coupon_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_self_buy_coupon_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN o.self_buy_coupon_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_self_buy_coupon_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN l.receipt_round_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_receipt_round_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN l.receipt_round_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_receipt_round_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (1, 3) THEN l.payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_payment_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type IN (2, 3) THEN l.payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_payment_amount FROM t_rob_order_operate_log l INNER JOIN t_rob_order o ON o.id = l.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE 1 = 1
